1	## Summary
2	
3	The `HasRigidPushforward` gate went from **four open leaves to one open statement**. Two leaves are now theorems, the third is reduced, and the infrastructure the third needs also landed. Seven new sorry-free modules (~2,700 lines), eight commits. There is deliberately **no** `instance : HasRigidPushforward` — so the task stays queued, as its own brief requires.
4	
5	The unlock was not cohomological. Both candidate anchors for the H⁰-finiteness leaf bottomed out at the same fact: the ℙ¹ chart ring had to be **free**, and the tree only had it **spanned**. The missing half was already written in the sibling project over a field, and no step of it uses the field hypothesis — one cross-project search replaced a session of re-derivation.
6	
7	## Progress
8	
9	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1ChartRing.lean`: new, 408 lines. `p1AwayAlgEquiv` — the chart ring of the integral model `Proj ℤ[X₀,X₁]` is a polynomial ring, over **any** commutative base ring. Also fills a mathlib gap (`HomogeneousLocalization` as an algebra over the *base*, not just the degree-zero part).
10	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1ChartSections.lean`: new, 457 lines. `Γ(ℙ¹_k, D₊(Xᵢ)) ≃ₐ[k] k[T]`. The injectivity the tree lacked, via a retraction from the `CommRingCat` section-ring pushout — its compatibility square is free because `Γ(⊤_Scheme)` is initial.
11	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Topology.lean`: new, 173 lines. Domains → `IsReduced` + `IrreducibleSpace` → `IsIntegral`, in ~30 lines rather than by chart-chasing.
12	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardRank.lean`: new, 619 lines. **Leaf 3 closed** — `p1RankIdentity_proved`, for *every* `k`-algebra (the `FiniteType` the gate assumes is not needed).
13	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean`: new, 441 lines. Leaf 4 reduced by affine-target descent (Stacks 01I8) from "no infrastructure at all" to one module-level bijectivity.
14	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange.lean`: new, 441 lines. The 02KG chart comparison at an arbitrary affine base change, plus the Čech square on **kernels** — what the route called "the genuinely missing piece".
15	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardInstance.lean`: new, ~160 lines. `instIsIntegralP1OverLeft`; `locallyFree` unconditional; `hasRigidPushforward_of_gammaBaseChange` — the gate from one hypothesis.
16	- `Picard/{Gate,Frontier,Rank,AffineDescent}.lean`: docstring corrections only, in two audit rounds.
17	
18	Every module: sorry-free, single-module `lake build` green, `#print axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
19	
20	## Issues
21	
22	- **Four of my modules were swept into another run's blanket integration commit** while in flight, so they carry the wrong task's trailers. Contents verified byte-identical; commit `3636b5ea2` is the record. Saved as memory — `git commit` answering "no changes added" does *not* mean the work was lost.
23	- **Two audit rounds found six overstatements, three of them in files the first repair commit had already edited.** The worst was false, not merely loose: "`hsurj` is subsumed by the `kerBaseChange` hypothesis" (counterexample `d = 0`), which would have licensed deleting a real hypothesis. A later round found the `k[x]` counterexample witnesses `hproj` *alone* — `hsurj`, `hfin`, `hbc` all hold in it — while the heading claimed three.
24	- `RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange.lean` is not yet in the root roll-up (out of my write set); requested from ajc-truth. All six earlier modules are rooted.
25	- Inbox is over its advisory limits (17 memories vs. cap 10); janitor escalated a concrete CLI fix rather than deleting live items.
26	- Heavy contention — three runs building concurrently, load ~50, swap exhausted. Several builds took 20–30× their real elaboration time.
27	
28	## Why I stopped
29	
30	**Partly advanced, deliberately not complete.** The done-criterion requires a genuine non-sorry instance producer, and `RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` has no producer — writing `instance : HasRigidPushforward` anyway is exactly the failure mode this task's own history warns about. Status left unset so it returns to the queue.
31	
32	Verification I ran before claiming: `#check` on both headline theorems shows only the three AJC-curve hypotheses plus the algebra data — nothing relocated into a producer-less instance binder — and both compile end-to-end from those hypotheses alone. A fresh-context review refuted the vacuity worry three ways (ℙ¹ is nonempty, is not a point, is not 𝔸¹) and confirmed the 4→3→1 arithmetic by printing signatures rather than reading docstrings. It also flagged, correctly, that the clean axiom check on `hasRigidPushforward_of_gammaBaseChange` carries **no** information, since it quantifies over a producer-less statement.
33	
34	## Next
35	
36	Attack `RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` and nothing else. Read `RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean`'s docstring first — it carries the route *and* four corrections to it. With the chart bricks landed, what remains is assembly plus one congruence helper: moving `moduleSectionDiffBase` statements from `π_A ≫ p` to `q` across the propositional `finiteMapToP1BaseChange_snd`, where the module structures sit inside the type. One focused session, and the risk is Lean engineering, not mathematics.

13	# The `HasRigidPushforward` gate: the `locallyFree` half, unconditionally
14	
15	`Picard/RigidPushforwardGate.lean` factored the B3 campaign gate
16	`Scheme.HasRigidPushforward` into four named leaves, and
17	`Picard/RigidPushforwardFrontier.lean` recorded the state after two of them
18	were discharged: three statements remained — integrality of `ℙ¹_k`, the rank
19	identity, and the `baseChange` field.
20	
21	**Two of those three are now theorems, and this file assembles them.**
22	
23	## What is closed
24	
25	* **`IsIntegral (ℙ¹_k)`** (`instIsIntegralP1OverLeft` below).  The frontier
26	  file recorded this as "genuine missing mathematics": mathlib v4.31 has
27	  `GeometricallyIrreducible`/`Reduced`/`Integral` for *affine* space and no
28	  integrality API for `Proj` at all.  It is now unconditional, in two steps.
29	
30	  `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1ChartSections.lean` identifies the standard chart
31	  section rings as polynomial rings,
32	  `Γ(ℙ¹_k, D₊(Xᵢ)) ≃ₐ[k] k[T]`.  The tree already had the *spanning* half
33	  (`span_pow_p1XSection_scaffold`, `RiemannRoch/Adelic/P1ChartData.lean` — the
34	  chart ring is the `k`-span of the powers of the chart coordinate, i.e. the
35	  evaluation `k[T] → Γ(V₀)` is surjective).  What was missing was injectivity,
36	  and it comes from the section-ring pushout: `V₀` is the fibre product of the
37	  affine `D₊(X₀) ⊆ Proj ℤ[X₀, X₁]` with `Spec k` over the terminal scheme, so
38	  mathlib's `isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen` presents `Γ(V₀)` as a
39	  `CommRingCat` pushout, and `IsPushout.desc` against
40	  `(ℤ[T] → k[T], k → k[T])` produces a retraction.  A surjection with a
41	  retraction is bijective.  The `ℤ[T]` input is
42	  `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1ChartRing.lean`'s `p1AwayAlgEquiv`, the same
43	  dehomogenisation argument over an arbitrary commutative base ring.
44	
45	  `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Topology.lean` turns "both chart rings are
46	  domains" into integrality: reducedness by `IsReduced.of_openCover`, and
47	  irreducibility because the (nonempty) overlap is a dense irreducible subset
48	  of each chart, hence of their union.
49	
50	* **`P1RankIdentity k A`** (`Picard/RigidPushforwardRank.lean`,
51	  `p1RankIdentity_proved`), for *every* `k`-algebra `A` — the `FiniteType`
52	  hypothesis the gate quantifies over is not needed.
53	
54	Consequently `P1RigidPushforwardStatement k A` and, for an AJC curve, the
55	gate's whole `locallyFree` field are unconditional theorems
56	(`p1RigidPushforwardStatement_proved`, `rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_proved`).
57	
58	## What remains — one statement
59	
60	The gate's second field, `Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A`.
61	`Picard/RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean` reduces it — by affine-target
62	descent, both sides of the adjunction mate being quasi-coherent on the affine
63	`Spec A'` — to the single module-level statement
64	`RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange C A`: bijectivity of the canonical
65	`Γ(Spec A', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Spec A, ⊤)} Γ(C_A, L) → Γ(C_{A'}, g'^* L)`.  That is the
66	classical `H⁰`-base-change fact, and it is *not* proved anywhere in the tree.
67	`hasRigidPushforward_of_gammaBaseChange` below is the honest statement of the
68	gate's remaining cost: **one** statement, not four.
69

71	`instance : HasRigidPushforward C`, because there is no producer for
72	`RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange`.
73

9	/-!
10	# Affine-target descent for the pushforward base-change mate
11	
12	The B3 campaign gate `Scheme.HasRigidPushforward` (`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`:373) has two
13	fields.  `Picard/RigidPushforwardGate.lean` ("Caveat on the `baseChange` field") and
14	`Picard/RigidPushforwardFrontier.lean` (item 3 of "What remains") both record that the second
15	one, `Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange` (`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`:342), has **no
16	infrastructure at all**: every `IsIso` theorem for the adjoint mate `pushforwardBaseChangeMap`
17	in this tree (`isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_isPullback`,
18	`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:1108, and its chart form :949) assumes `[IsAffineHom f]`,
19	whereas the gate's family `q : C_A ⟶ Spec A` is proper and emphatically not affine.
20	
21	This file replaces "no infrastructure" by a named, honest **reduction**: the whole field follows
22	from a single classical `H⁰`-base-change bijectivity of `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-modules.  It does *not*
23	prove that bijectivity — see "What remains" below — and it does not smuggle in the non-affine
24	case: only the two *bases* of the square are assumed affine, the fibre map `f` is arbitrary.
25	
26	## The reduction, in four steps
27	
28	* **§1 — affine-target descent.**  `Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map` and
29	  `Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop`: a morphism `φ : M ⟶ N` of quasi-coherent modules
30	  on an affine scheme is an isomorphism as soon as it is *bijective on global sections*.  The
31	  input is the affine structure theorem `Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent`
32	  (Stacks 01I8, `Picard/QuotScheme.lean`:2693) — the counit `Γ(M, ⊤)~ ⟶ M` is an isomorphism
33	  for quasi-coherent `M` — together with naturality of `Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans`.
34	  Naturality rewrites `φ` as `fromTildeΓ_M⁻¹ ≫ (Γφ)~ ≫ fromTildeΓ_N`, a composite of three
35	  isomorphisms, and the resulting `Iso` has `φ` as its `hom` by `rfl`.
36	
37	* **§2 — the mate on global sections.**  `isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_appTop_of_bijective`:
38	  over affine bases the `Γ(⊤)`-component of `pushforwardBaseChangeMap` *is* the canonical map
39	  `Γ(Y', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Y, ⊤)} Γ(f_* F, ⊤) → Γ(f'_* (g'^* F), ⊤)`, `b ⊗ x ↦ b · baseMap x`.  The
40	  source side is identified with the tensor product by
41	  `pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv` (`Picard/QuotScheme.lean`:4611) and the
42	  formula for the mate on the image of `baseMap` is `pushforwardBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap`
43	  (`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:828) taken at `V = O = ⊤`; simple tensors are handled
44	  by `b ⊗ x = b • (1 ⊗ x)` and `Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul`, and `TensorProduct.induction_on`
45	  propagates.
46	
47	  **Caveat, stated once and meant.**  §2 and §3 assume only `comm : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g`; the square
48	  is *not* assumed cartesian.  They are therefore exactly as strong as the bijectivity `hbij`
49	  handed to them, and must **not** be read as an unconditional Beck–Chevalley/base-change
50	  theorem: all the mathematical content of a base-change theorem still sits inside `hbij`, and
51	  without a cartesian square there is no reason for `hbij` to hold at all.
52	
53	* **§3 — the two combined.**  `isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_bijective_gamma`: with `Y`
54	  affine and the target of `g` of the form `Spec R'`, quasi-coherence of both mate ends is
55	  automatic (`pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom`, `Scheme.Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent`), so
56	  §1 upgrades the `Γ(⊤)`-bijectivity of §2 to `IsIso` of the mate itself.  **`f` is still not
57	  assumed affine** — this is precisely the case the two frontier docstrings report as missing.
58	
59	* **§4 — the gate's field.**  `Adelic.RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` names the residual
60	  `Γ`-level statement for the constant curve `C_A`, and
61	  `Adelic.rigidPushforwardBaseChange_of_gamma` derives `Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A`
62	  from it.  Properness of `C.hom` enters only through
63	  `MorphismProperty.pullback_snd`, to know that the two pullback families are proper (hence qcqs)
64	  and that `q_* L` is quasi-coherent.
65	
66	## What remains, and the route the probe identified for it
67	
68	`RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange C A` is **not proved here**.  The route found while building
69	this file, recorded so the next session does not re-derive it:
70	
71	1. Work on the 2-affine cover `(p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage π_A` of `C_A`, the preimage
72	   under the finite (hence affine) `π_A := finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C` of the standard 2-chart
73	   cover of `ℙ¹_A`.  Its Čech differential is **definitionally** the `ℙ¹_A` differential of
74	   `(π_A)_* L`: `Scheme.AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff_pushforward`
75	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:577) is proved by `rfl`.  So surjectivity of `d`
76	   obtained on `ℙ¹_A` transports to `C_A` by `exact`, with no transport lemma at all.
77	
78	2. Feed that surjectivity to `bijective_kerBaseChange_of_surjective`
79	   (`Picard/TwoTermFiniteFree.lean`:392) to get bijectivity of the kernel base-change map, and
80	   convert kernels to global sections on *both* sides with
81	   `Scheme.AffineCoverMVSquare.globalSectionsEquivKerModuleSectionDiffBase`
82	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Engine.lean`:287).
83	
84	3. **This step is now DONE** — see `Picard/RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange.lean`, which proves
85	   the **Čech square for an arbitrary affine base change**, i.e. the generalisation of
86	   `Picard/RigidPushforwardFiberChart.lean` §5–§7 from the fibre embedding `Spec κ(t) ⟶ Spec A`
87	   to an arbitrary `Spec A' ⟶ Spec A`:
88	
89	   * `isPushout_appLE_chartBaseChange` — the general-square replacement for
90	     `isPushout_appLE_fiberChart` (a one-liner from `isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback'`);
91	   * `exists_chartTensorEquiv` (↝ `exists_fiberChartTensorEquiv`) and
92	     `chart_smul_baseMap_res` (↝ `fiberChart_smul_baseMap_res`);
93	   * `exists_kerChartTensorEquiv` — the two-chart Čech square concluded on **kernels**,
94	     `Γ(Y',⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Y,⊤)} ker d ≃+ ker d'`, taking the `hker` of correction 1 directly and
95	     therefore carrying **no** flatness hypothesis.
96	
97	   All four are sorry-free and axiom-clean, and none of them needed the heartbeat headroom the
98	   fibre originals carry.  What is left of this route is therefore assembly: instantiate the
99	   engine's fourth conjunct at `B := Γ(Spec A', ⊤)`, feed `exists_kerChartTensorEquiv`, and
100	   convert kernels to global sections on both sides — with correction 4 below the remaining
101	   piece of real Lean engineering.  For the record, the intended signatures were:
102	
103	   ```
104	   theorem exists_chartTensorEquiv {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
105	       (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
106	       (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
107	       (hW' : IsAffineOpen (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
108	       letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) := (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
109	       letI := f.baseSectionsModule M W
110	       Nonempty { Θ : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) Γ(M, W) ≃+
111	           Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M, g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) //
112	         ∀ (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ(M, W)),
113	           Θ (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
114	             (f'.appLE (⊤ : Y'.Opens) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_top).hom b •
115	               pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) x }
116	
117	   lemma chart_smul_baseMap_res {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (M : X.Modules)
118	       {W W₀ : X.Opens} {W'' : X'.Opens}
119	       (hWW₀ : W₀ ≤ W) (hW'' : W'' ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ W₀) (hle : W'' ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
120	       (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ(M, W)) :
121	       (((((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom
122	           ((f'.appLE (⊤ : Y'.Opens) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_top).hom b •
123	             pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) x)) :
124	           Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M, W'')) =
125	         (f'.appLE (⊤ : Y'.Opens) W'' le_top).hom b •

129	
130	   Both are the affine-base-change analogues of bricks already proved for fibres; the first is
131	   Stacks 02KG in degree `0` on a single affine chart, the second its restriction naturality.
132	
133	4. **Dependency warning.**  This route puts the `baseChange` field *downstream* of the
134	   `IsIntegral (ℙ¹_k)` leaf of `Picard/RigidPushforwardFrontier.lean`: step 1 consumes the
135	   engine's **global** surjectivity of the Čech differential `d`, not merely the fibrewise
136	   `h¹ = 0` hypothesis that the gate carries.  Global surjectivity comes out of
137	   `p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing`, whose `H⁰`-finiteness anchor is exactly
138	   that leaf.  So the two fields of the gate are not independent along this route.  (That leaf
139	   is now proved — `Adelic.instIsIntegralP1OverLeft`, `Picard/RigidPushforwardInstance.lean` —
140	   so the dependency is discharged, not blocking.)
141	
142	## Four corrections to that route, from an adversarial re-check
143	
144	The route above survived an independent verification of §1–§4, but four of its *unproved*
145	steps were found to be booked at less than they cost.  Recorded so the next session does not
146	rediscover them:
147	
148	1. **Take the engine's fourth conjunct directly; do not re-derive it.**  Step 1 above proposes
149	   feeding global surjectivity of `d` to `bijective_kerBaseChange_of_surjective`
150	   (`Picard/TwoTermFiniteFree.lean`:392), which then also demands
151	   `Module.Flat Γ(Spec A, ⊤) Γ(M, U₁ ⊓ U₂)`.  That is unnecessary: the fourth conjunct of
152	   `p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing_of_isIntegral`
153	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Constants.lean`:540-544) is already
154	   `∀ B, Function.Bijective (TwoTerm.kerBaseChange (…) B)` for *every*
155	   `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-algebra `B`; instantiate `B := Γ(Spec A', ⊤)`.  This deletes the flatness
156	   obligation entirely, so the intended `Γ`-level statement should take
157	   `hker : ∀ B …, Function.Bijective (kerBaseChange (𝒰.moduleSectionDiffBase f M) B)` rather
158	   than a flatness-plus-surjectivity pair.
159	
160	2. **Get the `letI` binder list right, and elaborate the statement before writing any proof.**
161	   A `Module Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(M, ·)` instance exists only through `letI := f.baseSectionsModule M ·`,
162	   so every hypothesis mentioning `Γ(M, ·)` as a `Γ(Y, ⊤)`-module needs one — *in addition to*
163	   the `Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)` binder, which is never replaced.  How many depends on the
164	   statement, so copy from the closest existing one rather than guessing:
165	   `surjective_moduleSectionDiffBase_baseChange_residueField`
166	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardFiberChart.lean`:508-518) is about the whole Čech complex and
167	   carries the `Algebra` binder plus **three** `baseSectionsModule` binders (`U₁`, `U₂`,
168	   `U₁ ⊓ U₂` — there is no `⊤` binder); a statement about a *single* chart needs the `Algebra`
169	   binder plus **one**, at that chart; and the kernel comparison
170	   `exists_kerChartTensorEquiv` (`Picard/RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange.lean`) needs **seven**
171	   — the `Algebra` binder, three on `X`, three on `X'`.  (An earlier draft of this paragraph
172	   said "four binders, not the `Algebra` binder", which describes none of them; corrected after
173	   a fresh-context review checked it against the source, and the counts above are measured.)
174	   Two traps found while writing the seven-binder version: instance search does **not** see
175	   `g' ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.U₁` as `(𝒰.preimage g').U₁`, so the target-side binders must be spelled with
176	   `(𝒰.preimage g').Uᵢ`; and after `TensorProduct.induction_on` a goal that is syntactically
177	   `X = X` may still need an explicit `rfl`, because the two sides carry different-but-defeq
178	   module instances from the `letI` dictionary.  Either way: write the statement with a
179	   placeholder body and get it to elaborate first — that is where the time goes.
180	
181	3. **The glue to §3 is not free.**  §3's map lives on the tensor product formed with the
182	   *native* pushforward module structure (that is what
183	   `pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv` returns), while the Čech statement
184	   delivers the `baseSectionsModule` structure.  The tree proves these are only
185	   propositionally equal: `Scheme.Modules.pushforwardTopEquivBaseSections`
186	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Sheaf.lean`:408-421) is the identity on carriers but proves
187	   `map_smul'` via `Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app`.  So the two must be joined by a
188	   `TensorProduct` transport along that equivalence plus one `appLE_eq_app` rewrite for the
189	   target-side scalar.
190	
191	4. **Moving surjectivity from `π_A ≫ p` to `q` needs a lemma.**  The preimage-cover
192	   observation lands the Čech differential at the family `π_A ≫ p`, and `q` equals it only
193	   propositionally (`Adelic.finiteMapToP1BaseChange_snd`, `Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`:595,
194	   proved by `(pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)`).  Since the module
195	   structures sit inside the *type* of `moduleSectionDiffBase`, a naive `rw` on the morphism
196	   equality risks a "motive is not type correct" failure; a `subst`-style congruence helper is
197	   needed.  "Transports by `exact`" is true only within a fixed family.
198	
199	## Vacuity audit
200	
201	`RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` is of the shape `∃ s, (value of s on simple tensors) ∧
202	Function.Bijective s`.  This cannot be discharged by choosing a convenient `s`: simple tensors
203	generate `Γ(Spec A', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Spec A, ⊤)} Γ(q_* L, ⊤)` as an abelian group, and `s` is required
204	to be additive, so the prescribed values on simple tensors determine `s` **uniquely**.  The
205	existential is therefore a genuine bijectivity assertion about the canonical base-change map,
206	not an unconstrained choice.
207	
208	Sources: Stacks 01I8 (quasi-coherent modules on an affine scheme), Stacks 02KG (cohomology and
209	base change), Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, II §5; EGA III 7.9.9; Hartshorne III 12.11.
210	-/

226	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
227	/-- **A morphism of quasi-coherent modules on `Spec R` is an isomorphism as soon as its
228	image under the global-sections functor is.** -/
229	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map {R : CommRingCat.{u}}
230	    {M N : (Spec R).Modules} [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent] (φ : M ⟶ N)
231	    (h : IsIso ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) : IsIso φ := by
232	  have hM : IsIso M.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
233	  have hN : IsIso N.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent N
234	  have key : M.fromTildeΓ ≫ φ =
235	      (tilde.functor R).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) ≫ N.fromTildeΓ :=
236	    ((Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans (R := R)).naturality φ).symm
237	  let iM := @asIso _ _ _ _ M.fromTildeΓ hM
238	  let iN := @asIso _ _ _ _ N.fromTildeΓ hN
239	  let iG := @asIso _ _ _ _ ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) h
240	  let e : M ≅ N := iM.symm ≪≫ (tilde.functor R).mapIso iG ≪≫ iN
241	  have he : e.hom = φ :=
242	    calc e.hom
243	        = iM.inv ≫ ((tilde.functor R).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)
244	            ≫ N.fromTildeΓ) := rfl
245	      _ = iM.inv ≫ (M.fromTildeΓ ≫ φ) := by rw [key]
246	      _ = φ := Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc iM φ
247	  rw [← he]
248	  exact e.isIso_hom

250	-- The `rfl` bridging `(moduleSpecΓFunctor).map φ` with `φ.app ⊤` needs the functor's `map`
251	-- field unfolded, which is not reducible.
252	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
253	/-- Affine-target descent, section form: a morphism of quasi-coherent modules on `Spec R`
254	which is **bijective on global sections** is an isomorphism. -/
255	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop {R : CommRingCat.{u}}
256	    {M N : (Spec R).Modules} [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent] (φ : M ⟶ N)
257	    (h : Function.Bijective (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) : IsIso φ := by
258	  refine Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map φ ?_
259	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
260	  have hfun : ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) =
261	      ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) := rfl
262	  rw [hfun]
263	  exact h

276	/-- **The base-change mate is an isomorphism on global sections over affine bases as
277	soon as the canonical `Γ`-level base-change map is bijective.**  No cartesian hypothesis,
278	no affineness of `f`.
279	
280	The hypotheses say that `s` is *the* canonical map
281	`Γ(Y', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Y, ⊤)} Γ(f_* F, ⊤) → Γ(f'_* (g'^* F), ⊤)`, `b ⊗ x ↦ b · baseMap x`, and that it
282	is bijective; the conclusion is that the `Γ(⊤)`-component of the mate is an isomorphism.
283	
284	**This is not a Beck–Chevalley statement.**  The square is only assumed to commute, so the
285	theorem is exactly as strong as the bijectivity `hbij` supplied to it: all the content of a
286	base-change theorem still sits in `hbij`, which without a cartesian square has no reason to
287	hold. -/
288	theorem isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_appTop_of_bijective
289	    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
290	    (comm : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
291	    (F : X.Modules) [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).IsQuasicoherent]
292	    (e' : f' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)))
293	    (s : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) :=
294	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
295	         TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
296	             Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) →+
297	           Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F),
298	             (⊤ : Y'.Opens)))
299	    (hs : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) :=
300	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
301	          ∀ (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens))),
302	            s (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
303	              b • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj
304	                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F), (⊤ : Y'.Opens)) from
305	                pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' F e' x))
306	    (hbij : Function.Bijective s) :
307	    IsIso (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
308	      (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F) (⊤ : Y'.Opens)) := by
309	  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) :=
310	    (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
311	  obtain ⟨⟨eL, heL⟩⟩ := pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv g
312	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) (isAffineOpen_top Y') (isAffineOpen_top Y)
313	    (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens))
314	  have hcomm : ∀ w : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
315	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)),
316	      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F)
317	        (⊤ : Y'.Opens)).hom (eL w) = s w := by
318	    intro w
319	    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
320	    | zero => simp only [map_zero]
321	    | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, h₁, h₂]
322	    | tmul b x =>
323	      have hb : (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x :
324	          TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
325	            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens))) =
326	          b • ((1 : Γ(Y', ⊤)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) := by
327	        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
328	      have hsm : eL (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
329	          b • pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
330	            (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) x := by
331	        rw [hb, _root_.map_smul, heL]
332	      rw [hsm]
333	      have hlin : (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F)
334	            (⊤ : Y'.Opens)).hom
335	            (b • pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
336	              (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) x) =
337	          b • (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F)
338	            (⊤ : Y'.Opens)).hom
339	            (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
340	              (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) x) :=
341	        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul _ b _
342	      rw [hlin, pushforwardBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap f g f' g' comm F
343	        (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) e' x]
344	      exact (hs b x).symm
345	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
346	  have hfun : ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
347	      (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F) (⊤ : Y'.Opens))) =
348	      ⇑s ∘ ⇑eL.symm := by
349	    funext z
350	    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := eL.surjective z
351	    have hz : eL.symm (eL w) = w := eL.symm_apply_apply w
352	    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hz]
353	    exact hcomm w
354	  rw [hfun]
355	  exact hbij.comp (EquivLike.bijective eL.symm)
356	
357	end MateAppTop
358	
359	/-! ## §3. The combined descent -/
360	
361	section Combined
362	
363	variable {Y X X' : Scheme.{u}} {R' : CommRingCat.{u}}
364	
365	-- Discharging the three quasi-coherence side goals elaborates the mate's ends in full.
366	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
367	-- The `Γ(⊤)`-level statement of §2 has to be recognised as the `app ⊤` of the mate up to
368	-- non-reducible unfolding of the `Modules` hom structure.
369	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
370	/-- **Affine-target descent for the mate.**  If the target of `g` is `Spec R'`, the source
371	`Y` is affine, `f'` is qcqs and `F` is quasi-coherent with quasi-coherent pushforward, then
372	the base-change mate is an isomorphism as soon as the canonical `Γ`-level base-change map is
373	bijective.  **`f` is not assumed affine.**
374	
375	As in §2 the square is only assumed to commute, so the statement is exactly as strong as
376	`hbij`; it is not an unconditional base-change theorem. -/
377	theorem isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_bijective_gamma
378	    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Spec R' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Spec R') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
379	    (comm : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) [IsAffine Y]
380	    [QuasiCompact f'] [QuasiSeparated f']
381	    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
382	    [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).IsQuasicoherent]
383	    (e' : f' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens) ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)))
384	    (s : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Spec R', ⊤) :=
385	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
386	         TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Spec R', ⊤)
387	             Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) →+
388	           Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F),
389	             (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens)))
390	    (hs : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Spec R', ⊤) :=
391	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
392	          ∀ (b : Γ(Spec R', ⊤)) (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens))),
393	            s (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
394	              b • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj
395	                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F), (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens)) from
396	                pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' F e' x))
397	    (hbij : Function.Bijective s) :
398	    IsIso (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F) := by
399	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
400	      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)).IsQuasicoherent :=
401	    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) inferInstance
402	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F).IsQuasicoherent :=
403	    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g' F inferInstance
404	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj
405	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F)).IsQuasicoherent :=
406	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent f' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F)
407	  refine Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop _ ?_
408	  have hmt := isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_appTop_of_bijective f g f' g' comm F e' s hs hbij
409	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective] at hmt
410	  exact hmt
411	
412	end Combined
413	
414	/-! ## §4. The gate's `baseChange` field, reduced to a `Γ`-level statement -/
415	
416	namespace Adelic
417	
418	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
419	
420	/-- **The `Γ`-level base-change leaf.**  For the constant curve `C_A`, an invertible `L`
421	with fibrewise `h¹ = 0`, and every ring map `φ : A → A'`, the canonical additive map
422	`Γ(Spec A', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Spec A, ⊤)} Γ(C_A, L) → Γ(C_{A'}, (g')^* L)`,
423	`b ⊗ x ↦ b · (base-map image of x)`, is bijective.  This is the module-level residue of
424	`Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange` after affine-target descent.
425	
426	The existential over `s` is not a loophole: `s` is additive and its values are prescribed on
427	simple tensors, which generate the tensor product as an abelian group, so `s` is determined
428	uniquely and the statement really asserts bijectivity of the canonical map. -/
429	def RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
430	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Prop :=
431	  ∀ (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules),
432	    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
433	    (∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
434	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t) →
435	    ∀ (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A')
436	      (e' : (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
437	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
438	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens) ≤
439	        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
440	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
441	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⁻¹ᵁ
442	          ((pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) ⁻¹ᵁ
443	            (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens))),
444	      letI : Algebra Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤) Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A'), ⊤) :=
445	        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).appLE
446	          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens)
447	          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
448	      ∃ s : TensorProduct Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤) Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A'), ⊤)
449	          Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom
450	              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L,
451	            (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens)) →+
452	        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
453	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
454	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).obj
455	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
456	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
457	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).obj L),
458	          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens)),
459	        (∀ b x, s (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤)] x) =
460	          b • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
461	                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
462	                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).obj
463	                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
464	                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
465	                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).obj L),
466	                (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens)) from
467	            pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap
468	              (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
469	                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
470	                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) L e' x)) ∧
471	        Function.Bijective s
472	
473	-- Unfolding `RigidPushforwardBaseChange` exposes two nested pullback squares of schemes.
474	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
475	-- The `Γ`-level data supplied by `hgamma` is stated for the tautological square and must be
476	-- matched with the mate's arguments below reducible transparency.
477	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
478	/-- **The gate's `baseChange` field from the `Γ`-level leaf.**  For a proper `C`, the second
479	field of `Scheme.HasRigidPushforward` follows from the single `Γ`-level bijectivity
480	`RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange C A`, by affine-target descent (§1–§3). -/
481	theorem rigidPushforwardBaseChange_of_gamma
482	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
483	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
484	    (hgamma : RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange C A) :
485	    Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A := by
486	  intro L hL h1 A' _ φ
487	  haveI : IsProper (pullback.snd C.hom
488	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) :=
489	    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd (P := @IsProper) _ _ inferInstance
490	  haveI : IsProper (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
491	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
492	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) :=
493	    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd (P := @IsProper) _ _ inferInstance
494	  haveI := hL.isFinitePresentation
495	  haveI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
496	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom
497	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
498	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent _ L
499	  have e' : (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
500	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
501	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens) ≤
502	      (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
503	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
504	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⁻¹ᵁ
505	        ((pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) ⁻¹ᵁ
506	          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens)) := by simp
507	  obtain ⟨s, hs, hbij⟩ := hgamma L hL h1 A' φ e'
508	  exact isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_bijective_gamma _ _ _ _ pullback.condition L e' s hs hbij
509	
510	end Adelic
511	
512	end AlgebraicGeometry

8	/-!
9	# The chart comparison for an arbitrary affine base change
10	
11	`Picard/RigidPushforwardFiberChart.lean` §3–§6 proves the degree-`0` "cohomology and base
12	change" chart comparison (Stacks 02KG, Mumford *Abelian Varieties* II §5, EGA III 7.7.5) for
13	the **fibre** base change `Spec κ(t) ⟶ Y` of a family `f : X ⟶ Y` over an affine base.  This
14	file is that same package for an **arbitrary** base change: any cartesian square
15	
16	```
17	  X' --g'--> X
18	  |f'        |f
19	  v          v
20	  Y' --g---> Y
21	```
22	
23	with `Y` and `Y'` affine.  Nothing else changes — the fibre is used in
24	`RigidPushforwardFiberChart` only through `Scheme.Hom.isPullback_fiberι`, i.e. only through
25	the cartesianness of its square, so the generalisation is a retargeting rather than new
26	mathematics.
27	
28	`Picard/RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean` ("What remains, and the route the probe
29	identified for it", step 3) names exactly these two statements as the missing piece on the
30	route to `Adelic.RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange`, the single open statement that the campaign
31	gate `Scheme.HasRigidPushforward` still costs.
32	
33	## Contents
34	
35	* `isPushout_appLE_chartBaseChange` — the section-ring pushout
36	  `Γ(X', g'⁻¹W) = Γ(X, W) ⊗_{Γ(Y, ⊤)} Γ(Y', ⊤)` on an affine chart `W ⊆ X`.  This is
37	  `isPushout_appLE_fiberChart` (`Picard/RigidPushforwardFiberChart.lean` §3) with the fibre
38	  square replaced by an arbitrary cartesian square; it is the *only* place where the fibre
39	  entered, and its general-square input `isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback'` (§1 of the same file)
40	  was already available.
41	
42	* `exists_chartTensorEquiv` — the chart comparison
43	  `Γ(Y', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Y, ⊤)} Γ(M, W) ≅ Γ(g'^* M, g'⁻¹W)` for quasi-coherent `M`, sending
44	  `b ⊗ x` to `b · baseMap x`.  Generalises `exists_fiberChartTensorEquiv` (§5 there).
45	
46	* `chart_smul_baseMap_res` — restriction naturality of that comparison, which is what makes
47	  the family `(Θ_W)_W` a map of Čech complexes.  Generalises `fiberChart_smul_baseMap_res`
48	  (§6 there); it carried no fibre-specific input to begin with.
49	
50	* `exists_kerChartTensorEquiv` — the resulting Čech square on a bundled 2-affine cover, in the
51	  form the route needs: `Γ(Y', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Y, ⊤)} ker d ≅ ker d'` for the two-term Čech difference
52	  maps `d` on `X` and `d'` on `X'`, from the `H⁰`-purity hypothesis
53	  `∀ B, Function.Bijective (TwoTerm.kerBaseChange d B)`.  This is the kernel analogue of §7
54	  there (`surjective_moduleSectionDiffBase_baseChange_residueField`, which concludes on
55	  surjectivity at a fibre).
56	
57	Sources: Stacks 01HQ (affine base change of quasi-coherent modules), Stacks 02KG
58	(cohomology and base change) at `i = 0`; Mumford, *Abelian Varieties* II §5; EGA III 7.7.5.
59	-/
60	
61	set_option autoImplicit false
62	
63	universe u
64	
65	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace
66	
67	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
68	
69	namespace Adelic
70	
71	/-! ## §1. The chart-level section-ring pushout for a general affine base change -/
72	
73	/-- **The chart section-ring pushout of an arbitrary affine base change.**  For a cartesian
74	square
75	
76	```
77	  X' --g'--> X
78	  |f'        |f
79	  v          v
80	  Y' --g---> Y
81	```
82	
83	with `Y` and `Y'` affine, and an affine open `W ⊆ X`, the square
84	
85	```
86	  Γ(Y, ⊤) ----> Γ(X, W)
87	     |             |
88	     v             v
89	  Γ(Y', ⊤) ---> Γ(X', g'⁻¹W)
90	```
91	
92	is a pushout of commutative rings, i.e. `Γ(X', g'⁻¹W) = Γ(X, W) ⊗_{Γ(Y, ⊤)} Γ(Y', ⊤)`:
93	the chart `g'⁻¹W` of `X'` is the base change of the chart `W` along `Y' ⟶ Y` (Stacks 01HQ).
94	
95	This is `isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback'` (`Picard/RigidPushforwardFiberChart.lean` §1) at
96	`V = O = ⊤`, `U = W`, `U' = g' ⁻¹ᵁ W = (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) ⊓ (f' ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)`; equivalently, it is
97	`isPushout_appLE_fiberChart` (§3 there) with the fibre square `X_t → X`, `X_t → Spec κ(t)`
98	replaced by an arbitrary cartesian square.  Affineness of `g' ⁻¹ᵁ W` is *not* assumed: it
99	follows from cartesianness inside `isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback'`. -/
100	theorem isPushout_appLE_chartBaseChange {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}}
101	    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
102	    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
103	    {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
104	    CategoryTheory.IsPushout
105	      (f.appLE ⊤ W le_top)
106	      (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top)
107	      (g'.appLE W (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)
108	      (f'.appLE ⊤ (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_top) :=
109	  isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback' h le_top le_top
110	    (inf_top_eq _).symm (isAffineOpen_top Y) (isAffineOpen_top Y') hW
111	
112	/-! ## §2. The chart comparison isomorphism -/
113	
114	/-- **The chart comparison isomorphism for an arbitrary affine base change** (Stacks 02KG at
115	`i = 0`, chart form; Mumford AV II §5).  For a cartesian square
116	
117	```
118	  X' --g'--> X
119	  |f'        |f
120	  v          v
121	  Y' --g---> Y
122	```
123	
124	with `Y` and `Y'` affine, a quasi-coherent module `M` on `X` and an affine open `W ⊆ X` whose
125	preimage chart `g' ⁻¹ᵁ W` is again affine, the sections of the pulled-back module `g'^* M`

/-! ## §5. Substrate for `hH1`/`hH0` — the fibre square of the finite map
and the definitional Čech bridges

fibre `ℙ¹_t` with `(π_t)_* (L_t)` and transports the Čech difference map
across it.  This section lands the geometric substrate: the induced finite
map `π_t : C_t ⟶ ℙ¹_t` between the scheme-theoretic fibres, its cartesian
square over `π_A`, and the two *definitional* Čech bridges — the difference
map of a 2-affine cover for an (affine) pushforward literally *is* the
difference map of the preimage cover, and surjectivity of the difference
map transports across isomorphisms of module sheaves.  On top of this
substrate, `hH1`/`hH0` need the affine-morphism base-change isomorphism

glued form of `affinePushforwardPullbackBaseChange`), plus — for `hH1` —

/-- **The Čech difference map of an affine pushforward is the difference map
of the preimage cover** — definitionally: sections, intersections of
preimages, and restriction maps of `f_* M` over a 2-affine cover `V` all
agree with those of `M` over `V.preimage f`. -/
lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff_pushforward {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f] (V : Y.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : X.Modules) :
    V.moduleSectionDiff ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) =
      (V.preimage f).moduleSectionDiff M :=
  rfl

/-- **Naturality of the Čech difference map** in the module: a morphism of
module sheaves intertwines the difference maps of a 2-affine cover. -/
lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff_naturality {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare) {G G' : X.Modules} (φ : G ⟶ G')
    (a : Γ(G, V.U₁)) (b : Γ(G, V.U₂)) :
    V.moduleSectionDiff G' (φ.app V.U₁ a, φ.app V.U₂ b) =
      φ.app (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂) (V.moduleSectionDiff G (a, b)) := by
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun (ψ : Γ(G, V.U₁) ⟶ Γ(G', V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)) => ψ.hom a)
    (φ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₁)).op)
  have h₂ := congrArg (fun (ψ : Γ(G, V.U₂) ⟶ Γ(G', V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)) => ψ.hom b)
    (φ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₂)).op)
  simp only [AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at h₁ h₂
  simp only [moduleSectionDiff_apply, map_sub]
  exact congrArg₂ Sub.sub h₁.symm h₂.symm

/-- **Surjectivity of the Čech difference map transports across an
isomorphism of module sheaves.** -/
lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.surjective_moduleSectionDiff_of_iso {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare) {G G' : X.Modules} (e : G ≅ G')
    (h : Function.Surjective ⇑(V.moduleSectionDiff G)) :
    Function.Surjective ⇑(V.moduleSectionDiff G') := by
  intro c
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩ := h (e.inv.app (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂) c)
  refine ⟨(e.hom.app V.U₁ a, e.hom.app V.U₂ b), ?_⟩
  rw [V.moduleSectionDiff_naturality e.hom a b, hab]
  change ((e.inv ≫ e.hom).app (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)).hom c = c
  rw [e.inv_hom_id]
  rfl

This `Prop` is honestly TRUE for every finitely generated (equivalently,
noetherian quotient) `k`-algebra `A`; the gate `HasRigidPushforward`
quantifies it exactly there.  Truth for *arbitrary* `A` is not claimed —
that extension is milestone B2 (filtered colimits). -/
def RigidPushforwardLocallyFree (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Prop :=
  ∀ L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules,
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
    (∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t) →
    ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
      ∃ U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens, t ∈ U ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
              (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L) ≅
          _root_.SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin ((pullback.snd C.hom
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).fiberH0 L t))))

/-- **B3, step 1b (statement pin): the formation of the rigid pushforward
commutes with arbitrary base change** (Mumford AV II §5, Corollary 3;
campaign milestone B3(i), second conclusion).

Under the same hypotheses as `RigidPushforwardLocallyFree` (invertible `L`,
`h¹(L_t) = 0` at all scheme points), for **every** commutative ring
`A' : Type u` and **every** ring homomorphism `φ : A →+* A'` — no
finiteness, flatness or noetherian condition on `A'` (audit verdict in the
module docstring) — the canonical base-change comparison
`(Spec φ)^* (q_* L) ⟶ q'_* (g'^* L)` (`pushforwardBaseChangeMap`, the
adjunction mate) of the defining pullback square

```
  C_A ×_{Spec A} Spec A' --g'--> C_A
        |q'                        |q
        v                          v
     Spec A' ------Spec φ-----> Spec A
```

is an isomorphism.  The square is the *tautological* pullback of `q` along
`Spec φ`, so the statement needs no transport; the identification of its
corner with `C ×_k Spec A'` is the (separately proved, consumer-side)
pasting isomorphism. -/
def RigidPushforwardBaseChange (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Prop :=
  ∀ L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules,
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
    (∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t) →
    ∀ (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A'),
      IsIso (pushforwardBaseChangeMap
        (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
        pullback.condition L)

/-- **The B3 gate** (`HasPicScheme` pattern: `Prop` class, **no instances
anywhere in the tree** — supplied as a hypothesis by consumers and
discharged by the full B3 proof session, then deleted).

Content: for the smooth proper geometrically integral curve `C/k` of the
campaign, both B3 statement pins hold over every finitely generated
`k`-algebra `A` (Hilbert basis: such `A` is noetherian — the honest scope of
the Mumford AV II §5 two-term-complex argument; milestone B2 extends
consumers to arbitrary affine bases by filtered colimits).

Route for the discharge (recorded, not claimed here): push along the finite
`C_A ⟶ ℙ¹_A` (`finiteMapToP1BaseChange` below) and run the two-term finite
free replacement on the explicit 2-chart Čech complex of `ℙ¹_A`
(`p1BaseChangeCoverSquare` below); fallback: direct Čech on a 2-affine
cover of `C_A` (campaign risk register R1). -/
class HasRigidPushforward (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) : Prop where
  /-- Rank-`χ` local freeness over every finitely generated `k`-algebra. -/
  locallyFree : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A],
    RigidPushforwardLocallyFree C A
  /-- Arbitrary base change over every finitely generated `k`-algebra. -/
  baseChange : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A],
    RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A

variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]

/-- **B3 headline, local-freeness half** (extraction from the gate): for an
invertible `L` on `C_A` with fibrewise `h¹ = 0` at all scheme points, the
pushforward `q_* L` is, near every `t : Spec A`, free of rank
`h⁰(C_t, L_t) = χ(L_t)`. -/
theorem pushforward_locallyFree_of_h1_vanishing [HasRigidPushforward C]
    (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules)
    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (h1 : ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t)
    (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) :
    ∃ U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens, t ∈ U ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
            (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L) ≅
        _root_.SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
          (ULift.{u} (Fin ((pullback.snd C.hom
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).fiberH0 L t)))) :=
  HasRigidPushforward.locallyFree A L hL h1 t

/-- **B3 headline, base-change half** (extraction from the gate): under the
same hypotheses, the formation of `q_* L` commutes with every ring map
`A → A'`. -/
theorem pushforward_baseChange_of_h1_vanishing [HasRigidPushforward C]
    (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules)
    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (h1 : ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t)
    (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') :
    IsIso (pushforwardBaseChangeMap
      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
      (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))

/-- **The standard 2-chart affine cover of `ℙ¹_A`**: the preimage of the
standard cover `p1CoverSquare` of `ℙ¹_k` under the (affine, being a base
change of the affine `Spec A ⟶ Spec k`) projection `ℙ¹_A ⟶ ℙ¹_k`.  The
two-term complex `moduleSectionRes`/`moduleSectionDiff` on this cover is
the explicit 2-chart Čech complex of `ℙ¹_A` that the Mumford AV II §5
finite free replacement consumes. -/
noncomputable def p1BaseChangeCoverSquare :
    (Limits.pullback (p1Over k).hom
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).AffineCoverMVSquare :=

variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))

/-- **The base-changed finite map `π_A : C_A ⟶ ℙ¹_A`**: the functorial map
between the pullbacks along `Spec A ⟶ Spec k` induced by the finite
`π : C ⟶ ℙ¹` of the gate. -/
noncomputable def finiteMapToP1BaseChange [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] :
    Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) ⟶
      Limits.pullback (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) :=
  pullback.map C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
    (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
    (finiteMapToP1 C).left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
    (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact (Over.w (finiteMapToP1 C)).symm)
    (by simp)

/-- `π_A` is a map of families over `Spec A`: it commutes with the two
projections (the triangle `q = π_A ≫ p`). -/
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma finiteMapToP1BaseChange_snd [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] :
    finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C ≫
        pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) =
      pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) :=
  (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)

/-- `π_A` covers `π` over the chart projections. -/
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma finiteMapToP1BaseChange_fst [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] :
    finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C ≫
        pullback.fst (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) =
      pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) ≫
        (finiteMapToP1 C).left :=
  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

/-- **The square `C_A → C, π_A ↓ π.left, ℙ¹_A → ℙ¹` is cartesian**:
`C_A = C ×_{ℙ¹} ℙ¹_A` (pasting of pullbacks over the common base
`Spec k`).  This exhibits `π_A` as the base change of the finite `π.left`
along `ℙ¹_A ⟶ ℙ¹`, whence its finiteness. -/
lemma isPullback_finiteMapToP1BaseChange [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] :
    IsPullback (pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
      (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)
      (finiteMapToP1 C).left
      (pullback.fst (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) := by
  have hs : IsPullback
      (pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
      (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C ≫
        pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
      ((finiteMapToP1 C).left ≫ (p1Over k).hom)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) := by
    rw [finiteMapToP1BaseChange_snd, Over.w (finiteMapToP1 C)]
    exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
  exact IsPullback.of_bot hs (finiteMapToP1BaseChange_fst A C).symm
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))

/-- **`π_A` is finite** — `IsFinite` is stable under base change, and
`isPullback_finiteMapToP1BaseChange` exhibits `π_A` as a base change of the
finite `π.left`. -/
instance isFinite_finiteMapToP1BaseChange [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] :
    IsFinite (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C) :=
  MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback (P := @IsFinite)
    (isPullback_finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C) inferInstance

/-- **The pushforward factorization `q_* L ≅ p_* ((π_A)_* L)`** along the
triangle `q = π_A ≫ p` (pseudofunctoriality of the module pushforward).
This is the formal half of the B3 reduction: local freeness of `q_* L` is
local freeness of `p_* M` for `M := (π_A)_* L` on `ℙ¹_A`. -/
noncomputable def pushforwardFactorThroughP1Iso [HasFiniteMapToP1 C]
    (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L) :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (finiteMapToP1BaseChange_snd A C).symm).app L ≪≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)
      (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).app L).symm

/-- **The ℙ¹ engine (statement pin)**: the Mumford AV II §5 conclusion for
the projective line — for every finitely presented `M` on `ℙ¹_A`, flat over
the base, with fibrewise `h¹ = 0` at all scheme points, the pushforward
`p_* M` is locally free of pointwise rank `h⁰(ℙ¹_t, M_t)`.  This is the
`ℙ¹` instance of B3's local-freeness half, at the generality (coherent flat
`M`, not just line bundles) the finite-pushforward reduction requires.
Honestly TRUE for noetherian `A` (the two-term finite free replacement on
the 2-chart Čech complex `p1BaseChangeCoverSquare`); consumed as an explicit
hypothesis by `rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_p1` and discharged in the B3
session. -/
def P1RigidPushforwardStatement (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Prop :=
  ∀ M : (Limits.pullback (p1Over k).hom
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules,
    M.IsFinitePresentation →
    CoherentSheafFlat
      (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) M →
    (∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
      (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing M t) →
    ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
      ∃ U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens, t ∈ U ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj M) ≅
          _root_.SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin ((pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).fiberH0 M t))))

/-- **THE B3 REDUCTION** (campaign W1-B acceptance item): *B3 local freeness
for `C_A` follows from the ℙ¹ engine plus the finite-pushforward transfer
package along `π_A : C_A ⟶ ℙ¹_A`.*  Sorry-free; the four named hypotheses
are the honest dévissage lemmas of the B3 discharge session:

* `hfp` — the finite pushforward of an invertible module is finitely
  presented (finite morphisms are affine with module-finite section rings;
  Stacks 01XZ, 087T-grade);
* `hflat` — the finite pushforward stays flat over the base (affine
  pushforward does not change the underlying sections over affine bases);
* `hH1` — fibrewise Čech `h¹`-transfer: `H¹(ℙ¹_t, (π_A)_* L |_t) ≅
  H¹(C_t, L_t)` (exactness of affine pushforward + cohomology-and-base-change
  in the affine direction, Stacks 02KE/02KG-grade);
* `hH0` — the same transfer in degree 0 (`h⁰` match).

No finiteness on `A` is needed for this glue: the finiteness enters only
when discharging `hP1` (Mumford's argument needs `A` noetherian). -/
theorem rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_p1 [HasFiniteMapToP1 C]
    (hP1 : P1RigidPushforwardStatement k A)
    (hfp : ∀ L : (Limits.pullback C.hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules,
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hflat : ∀ L : (Limits.pullback C.hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules,
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
      CoherentSheafFlat
        (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L))
    (hH1 : ∀ (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules)
      (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)), LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
      (pullback.snd C.hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t →
      (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L) t)
    (hH0 : ∀ (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules)
      (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)), LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
      (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).fiberH0
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L) t =
      (pullback.snd C.hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).fiberH0 L t) :
    Scheme.RigidPushforwardLocallyFree C A := by
  intro L hL h1 t
  obtain ⟨U, htU, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hP1
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L)
    (hfp L hL) (hflat L hL) (fun s => hH1 L s hL (h1 s)) t
  refine ⟨U, htU, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  rw [hH0 L t hL] at e
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).mapIso (pushforwardFactorThroughP1Iso A C L) ≪≫ e

end Adelic

namespace Scheme.Modules

/-- **Global sections of a pushforward are the base-linear global sections of
the source.**  For a morphism `p : X ⟶ S` and a module `M` on `X`, the two
`Γ(S, ⊤)`-modules `Γ(S, p_* M)` and `Γ(X, M)` — the latter with the
`baseSectionsModule` structure of `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Engine.lean` §1 —
have the same carrier (`Scheme.Modules.pushforward_obj_obj`, `rfl`) and the same
scalar action: the pushforward acts through `p.app ⊤`, the `baseSectionsModule`
through `p.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top`, and those two ring maps agree
(`Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app`, using `p ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ = ⊤`).

This is the dictionary entry that lets a statement about the Čech complex of
`M` be read as a statement about the sheaf `p_* M`. -/
noncomputable def pushforwardTopEquivBaseSections {X S : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S)
    (M : X.Modules) :
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M (⊤ : X.Opens)
    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj M, ⊤) ≃ₗ[Γ(S, ⊤)] Γ(M, (⊤ : X.Opens)) :=
  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M (⊤ : X.Opens)
  { toFun := fun x => x
    map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
    map_smul' := fun r x => by
      have h : p.appLE (⊤ : S.Opens) (⊤ : X.Opens) le_top = p.app (⊤ : S.Opens) :=
        Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app p
      exact congrArg (fun (φ : Γ(S, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X, (⊤ : X.Opens))) =>
        (φ.hom r) • (show Γ(M, (⊤ : X.Opens)) from x)) h.symm
    invFun := fun x => x
    left_inv := fun _ => rfl
    right_inv := fun _ => rfl }

end Scheme.Modules

namespace Adelic

open Scheme

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

/-- **`Γ(Spec A, p_* M)` is the Čech `H⁰` of the two-chart cover of `ℙ¹_A`.**
For the projection `p : ℙ¹_A ⟶ Spec A` and a module `M` on `ℙ¹_A`, the global
sections of the pushforward are, definitionally, the global sections of `M`
(`Γ(p_* M, ⊤) = Γ(M, p ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) = Γ(M, ⊤)`), and their `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-module
structure is the `baseSectionsModule` structure of the family; the sheaf
condition on the two-element affine cover `{U₁, U₂}` then identifies them with

morphisms — in particular to the affine projection `ℙ¹_A ⟶ ℙ¹_k`, giving

    (V : Y.AffineCoverMVSquare) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f] :

/-! ## §2. Fibrewise `h⁰` and `h¹`-vanishing for a family -/

/-- The **fibrewise `h⁰`** of a sheaf of modules `L` on the total space of a
family `q : X ⟶ S` at a point `t : S`: the dimension over the residue field
`κ(t)` of the global sections of the restriction `L_t` of `L` to the
scheme-theoretic fibre `X_t = q.fiber t`,

`h⁰(t) = dim_{κ(t)} Γ(X_t, L_t)`.

The `κ(t)`-structure is `Scheme.Hom.fiberSectionsModule` (restriction of
scalars along `κ(t) → Γ(X_t, 𝒪)`), exactly the convention of
`Scheme.hilbertFunction`; when the dimension is infinite, `Module.finrank`
takes the junk value `0`.  This is the (P2-kit-independent) fibre `h⁰`
vocabulary of campaign milestones B3/B5/B6/J1/J3. -/
noncomputable def Hom.fiberH0 (q : X ⟶ S) (L : X.Modules) (t : S) : ℕ :=
  letI := q.fiberSectionsModule t (q.fiberModule t L)
  Module.finrank (S.residueField t) Γ(q.fiberModule t L, (⊤ : (q.fiber t).Opens))

=== baseSectionsModule ===
/-- **The `Γ(S, ⊤)`-module structure on module sections over the total space
of a family** `p : X ⟶ S`: restriction of scalars along the pullback ring
map `p.appLE ⊤ W : Γ(S, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X, W)` (every open `W` satisfies
`W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤` definitionally).  This is the definitional spelling of the
module structure in the pinned `CoherentSheafFlat` predicate (there stated
over a general affine `U ⊆ S`; the engine consumes it at `U = ⊤` of the
affine base `Spec A`), so flatness hypotheses transport by `rfl`.  Not an
instance (the family `p` is not inferable); activate with
`letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W` — the `Scheme.Hom.fiberSectionsModule`
pattern. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def Hom.baseSectionsModule (p : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules)
    (W : X.Opens) :
    Module Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(M, W) :=
  Module.compHom _ (p.appLE ⊤ W (le_top : W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).hom

/-- The scalar action of `baseSectionsModule`, definitionally. -/
lemma Hom.baseSectionsModule_smul_def (p : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) (W : X.Opens)
    (r : Γ(S, ⊤)) (m : Γ(M, W)) :
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
    r • m = (p.appLE ⊤ W (le_top : W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).hom r • m :=
  rfl

/-- **The section restrictions of `M` are `Γ(S, ⊤)`-linear** for the
`baseSectionsModule` structures: the presheaf restriction is semilinear over
the restriction of `𝒪_X` (`Scheme.Modules.map_smul`), and the two `appLE`
composites agree (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_map`). -/
lemma Hom.baseSections_res_smul (p : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) {W W' : X.Opens}
    (h : W' ≤ W) (r : Γ(S, ⊤)) (m : Γ(M, W)) :
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W'
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (r • m) =
      r • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m := by
  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W'
  rw [p.baseSectionsModule_smul_def M W r m, Scheme.Modules.map_smul,
    p.baseSectionsModule_smul_def M W' r]
  congr 1
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ : Γ(S, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X, W') => φ.hom r)
    (p.appLE_map (le_top : W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) (homOfLE h).op)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h1
  exact h1

/-- **The bundled `Γ(S, ⊤)`-linear section restriction** of a module on the
total space of the family `p : X ⟶ S`, for the `baseSectionsModule`
structures.  (`restrictₗ` of `Picard/QuotScheme.lean` is the sibling over
the section ring of the source open; this one is linear over the base.) -/
noncomputable def Hom.baseSectionsRes (p : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) {W W' : X.Opens}
    (h : W' ≤ W) :
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W'
    Γ(M, W) →ₗ[Γ(S, ⊤)] Γ(M, W') :=
  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W'
  { toFun := fun m => M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m
    map_add' := map_add _
    map_smul' := fun r m => p.baseSections_res_smul M h r m }

/-- The underlying function of `baseSectionsRes` is the presheaf restriction. -/
lemma Hom.baseSectionsRes_apply (p : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) {W W' : X.Opens}
    (h : W' ≤ W) (m : Γ(M, W)) :
    p.baseSectionsRes M h m = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m :=
  rfl

/-- **The `Γ(S, ⊤)`-linear difference-of-restrictions map** of a 2-affine
cover, for a module `M` on the total space of the family `p : X ⟶ S`: the
linear upgrade of `AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff` for the
`baseSectionsModule` structures.  This is the two-term complex `d : M⁰ → M¹`
that the finite replacement `TwoTermFiniteReplacement` consumes. -/
noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiffBase (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare)
    (p : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) :
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M V.U₁
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M V.U₂
    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)
    (Γ(M, V.U₁) × Γ(M, V.U₂)) →ₗ[Γ(S, ⊤)] Γ(M, V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂) :=
  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M V.U₁
  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M V.U₂
  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)
  { toFun := V.moduleSectionDiff M
    map_add' := map_add _
    map_smul' := fun r q => by
      rcases q with ⟨a, b⟩
      simp only [V.moduleSectionDiff_apply M, RingHom.id_apply, Prod.smul_fst,
        Prod.smul_snd]

theorem exists_gammaBaseChange_of_kerPure {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y'] [IsAffineHom g']
    (𝒰 : X.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hker : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) B],
      letI := f.baseSectionsModule M 𝒰.U₁
      letI := f.baseSectionsModule M 𝒰.U₂
      letI := f.baseSectionsModule M (𝒰.U₁ ⊓ 𝒰.U₂)
      Function.Bijective
        (AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.kerBaseChange (𝒰.moduleSectionDiffBase f M) B))
    (e' : f' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens))) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) := (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ s : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) →+
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M),
        (⊤ : Y'.Opens)),
      (∀ (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M, (⊤ : Y.Opens))),
        s (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
